subject: Islamic Studies

intro: Lesson 22: Promises, honesty and keeping a trust. To understand why keeping promises and trusts (amanah) is part of a Muslim's faith

questions.q: Explain why keeping a promise matters in Islam.
questions.a: Allah commands it and will ask about it (17:34); breaking promises is a sign of hypocrisy.
questions.model: Point: promises must be kept. Evidence: 'the commitment is ever questioned about' (17:34). Explain: Allah will ask us, so we only promise what we can do and then do it.

questions.q: Write a 'promise plan' in the portal response box: one promise you will make this week, how you will keep it, and what you will say if something goes wrong. Start: 'I promise to ...'
questions.a: A realistic promise with a plan and an honest back-up
questions.model: Teacher writes: 'I promise to read to my little brother every evening. I will do it after Maghrib.'

questions.q: why should we say in sha Allah when we promise?
